Bravo to water bowls
Quiet season has been kind to the desk

Gentle Moves, Happy Paws

The Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways has been in a good rhythm lately, with travelers asking smart questions and the team keeping things calm, clear, and friendly. The welfare coordinator has been checking comfort needs with care, while the ground team keeps carriers moving smoothly from one handoff to the next. <<FACT F047>> Small touches like steady voice, clean bedding, and a quick check on each pet have made a real difference, and the desk is proud of the way the whole operation has stayed warm and steady.

Across the network, we are also seeing better coordination between booking staff and the people who look after pets in transit. <<FACT F040>> That kind of detail helps everyone relax, from nervous first-timers to regular flyers with a well-traveled companion. Keep sending along concerns early, keep notes clear, and keep that same friendly pace. It is working well, and our pets are traveling with noticeably more ease.
